title: About Me
description: As Senior Android Developer and Sub Leader of the Mobile Department, I coordinate feature requests, updates, and task allocation across the team, and mentor developers through code reviews and technical guidance. My work spans fintech and enterprise Android apps built with Java and Kotlin, and during an assignment in Busan, South Korea (October 2022 to August 2023) I helped clarify requirements and coordinate delivery between the Cambodian and Korean teams.
